versions.changelog:
Initial release of JOOX Music Player skill (beta version):

- Enables controlling JOOX web music playback and management via agent-browser automation.
- Supports searching and playing songs, artists, albums, and playlists.
- Provides playback controls (play, pause, skip, shuffle, repeat, mute).
- Allows browsing charts and recommended playlists.
- Includes login and authentication workflow with state saving/restoring.
